visualCharacteristics.structure: Full-content-width borderless iframe (default height 51em) hosting a third-party web application started by a form POST

contentPattern.structure: Row 1 (one cell): link whose href is the application start URL; the link text is the accessible iframe title (e.g. "Apply for Credit application"). Optional row: method | POST or GET (default POST). Optional row: height | CSS length such as 51em or 816px (default 51em). The block is replaced by a borderless 100%-wide iframe when it nears the viewport; for POST a hidden form targeting the iframe is submitted once, for GET the iframe src is set. A loading indicator shows until the frame loads; the link stays as a fallback if JavaScript does not run
